selection.rule: Among beta=5, n=7 gamma-overestimates, choose gamma error closest to the median; ties by smaller gamma then sample ID. Reuse the same latent sample for beta=2.
selection.scope: Illustrates rightward parameter transfer; does not represent every sample or establish a universal bias direction.

criterion_ordinate: rho=sqrt(1-saved_loss); positive for increasing paired coordinates

figure_contract.criterion: beta=2/5 columns, n=7/15/30 rows, 50 curves per cell
figure_contract.transfer: One paired sample, rows rho, conditional beta, conditional eta
figure_contract.axes: Fixed linear gamma axes throughout, equal y scales within every quantity
